title: Scottish Fiscal Commission (SFC) — Economic & Fiscal Forecasting AI Deep-Dive Governance Pack
description: 12-entry-point AI governance framework for the Scottish Fiscal Commission (SFC) — Scotland's independent economic and fiscal forecasting institution — covering tax revenue, social security expenditure, GDP forecasting, fiscal sustainability, and budget scrutiny. Red lines: no AI-sole fiscal forecast; no taxpayer data outside UK jurisdiction; no AI model opacity.
